records.source: THE CHANNEL TOKEN IS RANKED, NOT READ AS A NUMBER, and that is the one decision here worth knowing about. ``C1``/``C2``/``C3`` and ``w1``/``w2`` and ``0``/``1``/``2`` all have to end up as channels 0, 1, 2, and there is no reading of ``C1`` that is right for all three -- a literal read makes the first set start at channel 1 and leaves channel 0 empty for ever. So the DISTINCT channel tokens are sorted (numerically on their trailing digits) and mapped onto 0, 1, 2 ... in that order. The mapping is therefore a property of the set of files, not of any one of them, which is why the window shows the assignment rather than describing the rule.

records.translation: 通道标记按排序确定，而不是作为数字读取，这是此处唯一值得了解的决定。``C1``/``C2``/``C3``、``w1``/``w2`` 以及 ``0``/``1``/``2`` 都必须最终成为通道 0、1、2，而对 ``C1`` 不存在一种对这三种情况都正确的解读——按字面读取会使第一组从通道 1 开始，通道 0 则永远为空。因此，互不相同的通道标记会被排序（按其末尾数字进行数值排序），并按此顺序映射到 0、1、2……。因此，这种映射是整组文件的属性，而不是其中任何单个文件的属性，这也是窗口显示分配结果而不是描述规则的原因。

records.label: spacr.measure.assign_paths_by_regex#6
records.source: THE SET IS THE TABLE'S, NOT THE DROP'S. ``table`` remembers which token owns which column in :attr:`FieldTable.channel_tokens`, and a later drop is ranked against the union of what it brings and what is already there. A token that ranks before one already placed renumbers the columns and MOVES the files already in them (:func:`_renumber_channels`), so every row agrees about what channel 0 is. Ranking each drop on its own instead would put a second field's ``C2`` in column 0 beside a first field's ``C1``, and the only sign of it would be in the database.
records.context: The set is the table's, not the drop's. ``table`` remembers which token owns which column in :attr:`FieldTable.channel_tokens`, and a later drop is ranked against the union of what it brings and what is already there. A token that ranks before one already placed renumbers the columns and MOVES the files already in them (:func:`_renumber_channels`), so every row agrees about what channel 0 is. Ranking each drop on its own instead would put a second microscope field of view's ``C2`` in column 0 beside a first microscope field of view's ``C1``, and the only sign of it would be in the database.
records.translation: 这组标记属于表格，而不属于单次拖放。``table`` 在 :attr:`FieldTable.channel_tokens` 中记住哪个标记对应哪一列，之后的拖放会根据它带来的标记与已有标记的并集进行排序。排在已放置标记之前的标记会重新编号各列，并移动已在这些列中的文件（:func:`_renumber_channels`），从而使每一行对通道 0 是什么保持一致。如果改为对每次拖放单独排序，就会把第二个视野的 ``C2`` 放在第 0 列，与第一个视野的 ``C1`` 并列，而唯一的迹象只会出现在数据库中。

records.source: spaCR had a fit-on-load, wheel-zoom, drag-pan image canvas already: the QC field browser's own ``_FieldView``. Item 473's raw-versus-enhanced window needed the same thing twice over, and a third copy of "a QGraphicsView with a pixmap in it" is how a codebase ends up with three that behave subtly differently. So the field browser's view moved here unchanged, under a name that says it is shared, and the browser goes on using it under its old one.
records.context: spaCR had a fit-on-load, wheel-zoom, drag-pan image canvas already: the QC microscope field of view browser's own ``_FieldView``. Item 473's raw-versus-enhanced window needed the same thing twice over, and a third copy of "a QGraphicsView with a pixmap in it" is how a codebase ends up with three that behave subtly differently. So the microscope field of view browser's view moved here unchanged, under a name that says it is shared, and the browser goes on using it under its old one.
records.translation: spaCR 早已有一个加载时适配、滚轮缩放、拖动平移的图像画布：QC 视野浏览器自己的 ``_FieldView``。第 473 项的原始与增强对比窗口需要两个同样的东西，而第三份 “一个装着 pixmap 的 QGraphicsView” 副本，正是代码库最终出现三个行为略有不同的实现的原因。因此，视野浏览器的视图被原样移到这里，换了一个表明它是共享组件的名称，而浏览器继续以旧名称使用它。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.zoom_view#2
records.source: WHAT IS NEW HERE IS THE TIE. records.source: WHY IT IS NOT VERBOSE LOGGING. Verbose logging only decides which log records are kept, so it has no account of memory to give. The function tracer that it once installed fired on every call and every return, and it cost twenty times the startup. An account taken through a tracer would describe the traced program rather than the real one, which is exactly the program nobody wants measured. So this samples instead: one psutil read a second, on a daemon thread that is never the GUI thread, on an otherwise unperturbed run. Three states rather than a checkbox, because the useful default is not "off" -- the most valuable resource data comes from runs nobody expected to fail.

Heavy tails, mixed populations and segmentation defects can all trigger it; the flag does not identify which is present. Border objects are excluded from every size statistic, exactly as ``diameter._region_diameters`` excludes them, because a truncated object's area is a lie.

records.source: ``measure_crop`` is the expensive step in spaCR: it opens every mask, cuts every object out of every channel, computes hundreds of features per object and writes them to SQLite. On a full plate that is hours. A plate whose segmentation collapsed — a channel out of focus, a diameter two-fold wrong, a confluent monolayer that fused into slabs — costs exactly the same hours and then produces a measurement table that has to be thrown away. The failure is obvious from the masks alone; nobody looks, because looking means opening a thousand ``.npy`` files by hand. Mask statistics can highlight suspicious fields, but cannot establish their cause or validate biological interpretation.

records.source: ``under-segmentation`` (fused objects) Detected the way :mod:`spacr.diameter` detects it, and for the same reason: **both halves of the signature are required**. The field must be dense enough for fusion to be the explanation (foreground at or above ``seg_qc_foreground_fraction``, default 0.35 — the same number ``diameter.estimate_diameters(fused_fraction=...)`` uses, because it is the same question), *and* the mask must under-count what the pixels support: either one label covers more than ``seg_qc_max_object_fraction`` of the field (0.25, again diameter.py's number), or the Euclidean distance transform of the foreground resolves at least ``seg_qc_split_ratio`` (2.0) inscribed-circle maxima per mask object. Requiring both matters in each direction: a dense but correctly separated field reaches 35% foreground and is fine, while an elongated or hollow object shatters the distance transform into several maxima and is also fine. diameter.py demands a 5-fold seed excess because it compares against raw Otsu components, where a confluent monolayer is one blob; here the comparison is against a Cellpose mask that already separates most objects, and the smallest fusion worth catching — every object being a welded pair — is exactly 2. Large, irregular or confluent biological objects can also trigger the heuristic; confirm boundaries against the raw images.

records.source: ``over-segmentation`` (shattered objects) Two signatures. Absolutely: at least ``seg_qc_tiny_fraction`` (0.30) of the field's objects are under ``seg_qc_min_diameter`` (5 px) across — spaCR's diameter estimator already discards components below 4 px as debris, but these defaults must be adapted for genuinely small objects. records.translation: timeflows 方案（``features/future/426``）依赖于关于训练数据的一个前提：一个对象在其出现的每一帧中都保持“相同的标签”。时间流预测头被训练为从帧 ``t`` 中某个对象的像素指向该对象在帧 ``t+1`` 中的中心，而唯一能说明 ``t+1`` 中哪个对象是同一对象的就是标签。如果标注在某个对象死亡或离开后回收了它的标签，模型就会被训练为指向一个无关的细胞，而且之后的任何评分都发现不了——留出检验会打乱同样错误的标签，并与自身保持一致。
